integrity.scientific_provenance: The claim is supported by a complete geometric and probabilistic proof and reproducible numerical diagnostics; classical record-statistics consequences are not claimed novel independently.

scientific_limitations: The theorem is for independent Haar one-dimensional sections of a planar disk with affine objective and exact full steps; it does not cover the motivating article's damped algorithms, nonlinear objectives, other convex bodies, or non-Haar sampling. Historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Exact record dynamics of one-dimensional Haar-section optimization on the disk
